en: Black‑and‑white photo of a rural mountain scene with a wooden lodge or café on a hillside, a gravel road in the foreground, and a row of mid‑20th‑century cars parked along the roadside. Forested slopes rise behind the building, and a small ski‑lift or rope‑tow structure is visible on the hillside, suggesting a ski or mountain resort. No visible caption or printed border text appears on the image side.
